sources.prompt:
Create ONE original native-drawn pixel-art CHARACTER ANIMATION ATLAS, transparent RGBA, portrait aspect approximately 1024 x 2048, STRICTLY FOUR COLUMNS by EIGHT ROWS = EXACTLY 32 independently drawn full-body poses. Reference image is only the character identity/costume guide, not a layout to reuse. Keep the same detailed pixel-art style and original Final Fantasy VIII version, clean discrete pixels, readable anatomy. Each row has exactly four sequential frames with clearly different full body actions and limb positions. All 32 drawings must be visibly distinct; never duplicate a tile, mirror an old pose, or merely change a glow. Each cell is roughly square, equal-sized, with generous entirely transparent gutters on every side and 10% safe padding. No subject or effect may touch another cell, no cropped shoes, head, weapon, rope, flowers or hands. Every cell centered consistently, approximate common foot baseline per row. Facing mostly screen-right at 3/4 side view. No panels, border lines, text, labels, caption, title, watermark, scenery backdrop, checkerboard or ground rectangle. Transparency must be actual alpha, including between figures. Respect age, silhouette, clothing and weapon, no body redesign. Eight rows in this EXACT order: row1 intro, row2 outro, row3 roundVictory, row4 roundDefeat, row5 fatality (non-gory adapted final flourish, no victim, no execution), row6 victory, row7 defeat, row8 super. Rows 3 and 6 must look clearly different; rows 4 and 7 must look clearly different; row 5 and row 8 each need their own fully distinct sequence. Not an official ripped sprite sheet, but original purpose-drawn adaptation.

LAGUNA LOIRE from Final Fantasy VIII. Reference costume: adult man with long brown ponytail, blue military-style jacket over white top, brown trousers and belt/chain, black fingerless gloves and heavy black boots. Add his authentic compact machine gun only when called for, NOT a sword, revolver, bow or magic staff.
ROW 1 INTRO: 1 steps in with machine gun carried low in both hands; 2 raises head and sweeps free hand through long hair; 3 brings gun to ready at chest; 4 assumes relaxed staggered guarded stance with gun angled down-right.
ROW 2 OUTRO: 1 lowers machine gun from shoulder; 2 turns torso three-quarter backward; 3 waves over shoulder with left hand while carrying gun low; 4 takes a departing step left with ponytail trailing.
ROW 3 ROUND VICTORY: 1 drops aiming elbow with relieved expression; 2 gives a small thumbs-up at chest; 3 rubs back of head sheepishly while shifting weight; 4 places left hand on hip and grins with gun pointed safely down.
ROW 4 ROUND DEFEAT: 1 flinches sideways with one boot skidding; 2 drops to one knee and braces gun by knee; 3 pushes up with hand on thigh; 4 regains low defensive crouch, tired but standing ready.
ROW 5 NON-GORY FINALE: 1 plants boot forward and braces the machine gun at shoulder; 2 releases a short compact muzzle-flash burst toward empty right; 3 pivots through recoil in a lower wide-legged follow-through; 4 safely lowers smoking muzzle and raises two fingers in a confident salute. No enemy body.
ROW 6 MATCH VICTORY: 1 straightens with gun resting low along right side; 2 raises left arm overhead in relieved cheer; 3 opens both arms in exuberant celebration keeping barrel down; 4 leans back laughing with hand on forehead and ponytail bouncing.
ROW 7 MATCH DEFEAT: 1 visibly staggers holding side; 2 kneels with head bowed and gun resting on ground; 3 sits back on heel with one hand on floor; 4 settles seated with head lowered, gun safely beside boot, exhausted non-graphic.
ROW 8 SUPER DESPERADO: 1 throws a small grenade with right arm while the left hand reaches a clearly visible SHORT vertical rope above his head, entire rope end contained in cell; 2 hangs one-handed from rope with knees bent and machine gun braced in free hand; 3 hangs in a different extended-leg swinging posture and fires the machine gun diagonally down-right with small ballistic muzzle flashes; 4 releases rope, lands on bent knees and lowers weapon amid a few tiny dissipating smoke puffs. Rope/grenade/gun must be readable, no energy beam, no wings, no giant fireball, no victim. Keep every rope segment fully inside its own frame.
sources.sourceReference: Final Fantasy VIII (1999), Laguna Loire — Desperado Limit Break: thrown grenade and one-handed machine-gun fire while hanging from a rope.

SELPHIE TILMITT from Final Fantasy VIII, same youthful game appearance and proportions as reference. Brown short bob with outward-flipped ends, green eyes, original modest sleeveless YELLOW zip-front dress with matching hem length, blue wristbands and BROWN boots. Age-appropriate nonsexual portrayal. Her original weapon is a pair of NUNCHAKU (two dark handles joined by short chain); depict them only when described, no staff, sword, gun or giant chain.
ROW 1 INTRO: 1 walks in holding folded nunchaku safely at her side; 2 raises free hand in cheerful greeting; 3 brings the paired nunchaku handles together at chest level; 4 settles in a light ready stance with bent knees and friendly determined face.
ROW 2 OUTRO: 1 gently lowers the folded weapon; 2 pivots left with bob swinging; 3 waves backward over shoulder; 4 takes a jaunty departing step with other arm lowered.
ROW 3 ROUND VICTORY: 1 relaxes from guard with happy smile; 2 performs a small one-arm fist pump near shoulder; 3 springs on toes with hands at chest; 4 gives bright thumbs-up with weight on one leg.
ROW 4 ROUND DEFEAT: 1 recoils with forearms raised defensively; 2 drops to one knee and steadies herself with fingertips; 3 brushes off her knee with tired expression; 4 returns to a low guarded stance with folded nunchaku held close.
ROW 5 NON-GORY FINALE, PEACEFUL THE END VARIANT: 1 clasps hands at heart with eyes gently closing; 2 extends one open hand while a tiny arc of wildflower petals appears beside her; 3 turns in a small calm circle with both arms open and a contained crescent of daisies at boots; 4 holds a soft relieved smile with palms open as petals settle. Supportive narrative resolution, no attacks, enemy, execution, rays, explosions or dead body.
ROW 6 MATCH VICTORY: 1 jumps with knees bent and arms lifted happily; 2 lands and playfully raises one foot backward with hands open; 3 claps hands at cheek level in festival delight; 4 spreads arms in exuberant friendly victory.
ROW 7 MATCH DEFEAT: 1 slumps with weapon lowered and sad face; 2 sinks onto both knees with shoulders bowed; 3 sits sideways with knees folded, one hand braced on floor; 4 rests seated with hands on knees and head bowed, exhausted but unharmed.
ROW 8 SUPER THE END: 1 raises both empty hands gently from waist level while folded nunchaku stays safely at belt; 2 opens arms outward as a SMALL TRANSPARENT-EDGED patch of green meadow and white/yellow wildflowers blooms directly under boots, no scenery rectangle; 3 looks upward with one arm high and one arm outward while loose flower petals drift around her, the tiny wildflower patch now fuller; 4 lowers palms peacefully, softens expression and takes a small step as meadow petals drift away. This row is quiet non-offensive narrative support, exactly meadow/flowers motif of The End adapted to a sprite. No beam, no damaging magic, no scythe, skull, death imagery, enemy or execution. Native hand/foot/body posture changes must make all four super frames and all finale frames distinct.

sources.promptSemanticClarification: Le prompt historique original est conservé mot pour mot pour la traçabilité. Ses termes « support » et « non-offensive » décrivaient à tort la mécanique : ils concernent ici uniquement la direction visuelle calme, prairie/fleurs, sans gore. The End termine le combat et élimine les ennemis ; son effet offensif/résultat demeure celui du moteur, sans soin ni buff.

sources.prompt:
Draw one NEW original pixel-art animation strip of Laguna Loire from Final Fantasy VIII (1999), actual transparent RGBA, FOUR columns by ONE row, EXACTLY FOUR complete independently drawn full-body frames. Wide landscape strip approximately 1536 x 512, four equal square cell spaces with generous transparent gutters and 12% padding all around. The first reference is the costume identity; second reference is the existing 8-row atlas only to match pixel-art style. Draw FOUR ENTIRELY NEW POSES for the adapted Desperado finale. Do NOT copy, crop, mirror, retouch or duplicate any of the four existing bottom-row super poses. This strip will replace only row index4 of an atlas, all other rows are preserved externally. No need to redraw eight rows, draw exactly one row of four new drawings, and no labels.
Laguna is the same adult man as local reference, long dark-brown ponytail, short blue military jacket over white undershirt, brown trousers with belt/chain, black fingerless gloves, heavy black boots. His weapon is a black compact MACHINE GUN. No sword, pistol, bow, staff, armor, new uniform or age change. Detailed crisp native pixel art, no soft vector style or 3D render.
The canonical identity of Desperado MUST be unambiguous: thrown grenade, hanging from a rope by ONE HAND, machine-gun fire from the other hand, then release and landing. A short visible vertical rope segment must start INSIDE each applicable cell above Laguna's raised gripping hand, not at the edge; keep all ropes/feet/gun/flashes within the frame. Exactly two arms, two hands and two legs, no extra hand holding gun. The machine gun can hang on its shoulder strap in frame1 so the other hand can throw the grenade.
FRAME1 LEFTMOST: Laguna is ALREADY SUSPENDED by his raised LEFT HAND on the rope, body leaning back diagonally toward screen-left, right knee tucked up and left boot extending back. His right arm is drawn back with a small grenade in hand at shoulder level about to throw it toward empty screen-right. Machine gun hangs safely across lower torso on its strap. Keep the pose visibly airborne, both boots off ground. This must differ from the old upright grenade-throwing bottom-row pose.
FRAME2: Still hangs by his left hand on the rope, body swings toward screen-right and is diagonally tilted, both bent legs angled back toward screen-left. The thrown small grenade is now airborne at far right with a tiny short arc. Laguna's RIGHT HAND now holds the machine gun, aimed diagonally down-right, elbow held out. A compact ballistic muzzle flash and tiny shell indicate firing. Both feet clearly above ground, gun one-handed only.
FRAME3: Still suspended by LEFT HAND, turns torso more toward viewer and swings to the other side with one knee high and the other leg stretched down-left. His RIGHT arm extends the machine gun level-right in a strong one-handed burst with compact muzzle flashes. Ponytail swings opposite his body. The silhouette, gun angle, face angle and both legs must clearly differ from frames1/2 AND the old bottom-row frames. The rope is plainly gripped, not magically levitating.
FRAME4 RIGHTMOST: Has just RELEASED the rope and returns to the floor in a new wide split-foot landing: left boot planted far forward, right knee nearly touching ground behind, body leaning forward, gun lowered across the right thigh and left arm reaching sideways for balance. A loose SHORT rope end curves above-left of him entirely within cell; the hand is not attached now. A few small smoke puffs and dust flecks settle, no explosion. The pose must be different from the old two-knee landing at bottom-right.
No opponent, victim, gore, death image, giant explosion, energy beam or invented power. It is an adapted combat finale of his named Limit Break. Use native drawing of distinct full-body actions, not the same pose with different VFX. No rectangular background, panel, text, labels, grids, watermark or checkerboard. Absolute transparent alpha between and around all four drawings. Every head, rope end, glove, boot and gun tip must be complete and not clipped.
